title: 第3章 奴隶找到绿点的位置第4章 买来的奴隶居然是
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
菲尔德被奴隶市场的臭味，折磨得鼻子发酸，那些吝啬的商人就是吸血鬼，不肯花费一个铜子给奴隶洗个澡。五六个奴隶只能蜷缩在一个狭小的笼子里，吃喝拉撒睡全在笼子里解决。
没有**，没有尊严，甚至因为从小的教育，连自尽的权力都没有。
放在外面的笼子里，不少女奴隶身上没有哪怕一片破布，一览无余地暴露两块软肉给路人观看，这也是一种营销手段，还很成功，每天都会有满口烂牙的老光棍来欣赏。
“大人，要买奴隶吗？农庄必备，都是勤快的好手。”
“稀有的精灵奴隶，只要一千金币！”
“新店开张，大人快来看！”
菲尔德穿着得体的黑色长袍，挎着一柄精钢长剑，长相清秀，一看就是有钱的主。奴隶贩子们两眼放光，他们最爱和贵族打交道，一来贵族消费能力强，不像那帮来过眼瘾的**丝，只看不买。二来，贵族对奴隶的消耗可谓惊人，没几天就当回头客。
在贵族老爷眼里，奴隶甚至不如自己养的鹰犬，随意就弄死了。
菲尔德扫过关着奴隶的铁笼，他们眼中连基本的神采都没有，蓬头垢面的样子，光凭借面孔难以分辨男女，身上还有狰狞的鞭伤，偶尔有奴隶对视上菲尔德的眼睛，便立刻低下头，瑟瑟发抖。
“多少钱？”根据地图显示，绿点就在这帮奴隶中，菲尔德一边寻找，一边问价。
“大人，不同人种价格差别巨大。”
长得和多来a梦里小夫那样尖嘴猴腮的商人，摸搓着手掌“哥布林、半身人和匹格人，都是10银币，亚人20银币，兽人60银币，若是想要买玩物，嘿嘿，那价格可没有上限。”
商人坏笑着指向屋内关在大笼子里的奴隶，最引人瞩目的还是叫价一千的精灵。
长相极美，穿着暴露的轻纱，露出雪白的肌肤。但眼中无神，像个傻子。
“这只精灵被哥布林玩坏了，至少生了二十六胎。哈哈，但依旧是抢手货。我打算送往拍卖行，到时候可不是一千金币能买到的，要不要考虑一下？”
“我对她没兴趣。”绿点不是她，菲尔德也没这么多钱买一个玩物，当即摇头，“人类奴隶多少钱？”
“人类聪明且更懂得服从，男性奴隶要40银币，女性为25银币，不过都是用来干活的，您要是想找点乐子，我还是推荐精灵，就算不拿来玩乐，杀掉吃肉或是制作魔法道具，都是不错的选择。”
菲尔德一阵恶寒，这个世界，贵族可不是电视剧里优雅体面的存在，而是封建残暴的恶徒。
听闻精灵的血肉能滋阴补阳，骄傲的精灵立刻就端上了餐桌，哪怕她们和人类很像。
闲聊间，菲尔德找到了绿点的位置，他的视线挪到了角落处的铁笼，一个绿点就像游戏里的指引，浮现在笼子顶上。

是亚人，并且是白狼亚人，拥有红色瞳孔，耳朵和尾巴则是和狼一样。
此时，穿着粗糙麻衣的她，趴在阴冷潮湿的笼子里，一动不动，只有眼睛时不时瞥向商人腰间的钥匙。
“少见的草原物种，我们的捕奴队可是花了不少力气，才攻破他们的据点，那些该死的野蛮人，战斗意志非常顽强。”商人用得意的表情诉说着残酷的事实，“想玩狼亚人的话，您最好带着仆从协助，不然一不小心，她们可能会咬断嘿嘿，只可意会不可言传。”
“兽耳娘？”
菲尔德激动坏了，作为一个资深的蓝星宅男，他对红瞳兽耳娘没有半点抵抗力。
像逗狗一样，菲尔德小心地将手探过去，试图摸摸她的脑袋。
“呼呜呜~”
“您最好当心点。”管家卡奥皱着眉头。
兽耳娘喉咙里发出威胁的低吼声，猩红的眸子中映射出危险的光芒，骑士队长康纳已经准备好拔剑“菲尔德大人，最好别碰他们，我可不希望去夜幕领之前，出什么岔子。”
“没必要这么紧张，她蛮可爱的。”话是这么说，菲尔德是个听劝的人，当即收回手，他从兽耳娘眼中看出了逞强和沮丧，可爱又可怜，菲尔德整理着衣襟，“多少钱？”
“只要三个金币！”商人看出了菲尔德的**，闭着眼睛涨价。
一枚金币等于一百银币，一银币则是一百铜币。
菲尔德板着脸，眼睛微眯“刚才说亚人只要20枚银币，你想要戏耍一个贵族？”
“哦，她是特殊的，长得非常漂亮不是吗？才捕获了不久，保证是处女，而且没被贱民们肮脏的眼睛偷窥过。她也是送去拍卖场的展品，这样的极品容貌，可惜是亚人，不洁的生物！否则300枚金币我也不会出售的。”
“五十银币，不要挑战我的耐心。”菲尔德双手环抱胸前，用画大饼的语气，诱惑道，“我马上要去上任我的领地，购买的玩物和奴隶，绝不仅她一个人。做一次生意，还是做无数次生意，我相信你心里有数。”
“嘶~”这话挠到了商人内心的**。
商人内心挣扎一番，结交一个拥有领地的实权贵族，绝对是个好主意，只好咬牙“那得看你购买的数量了。”
管家则是疑惑地瞥了眼菲尔德，在以前，菲尔德可不会砍价，只会同情商人的艰难。
在菲尔德精挑细选之下，购买了100人类奴隶和100亚人奴隶，其中男人120人。
加上菲尔德看中的兽耳娘，花费53枚金币。

“大人，这是奴隶的灵魂契约，都是神选者验证过的。”
“契约？”菲尔德接过羊皮纸，上面密密麻麻写着一串名字。
“是的，这是用奴隶的血发下的誓言，违抗您意志的人，会被神火烧成灰烬。”商人猥琐地笑着，将牵着奴隶的绳索递过来，“所以，您可以为所欲为了，玩的开心，我亲爱的顾客。”
“我会的。”菲尔德摆摆手，反正去了诅咒之地，玩不开心的话，多半要被腐化杀死了。
content_en:
Field's nose was sore from the smell of the slave market. Those stingy businessmen were vampires and would not spend a copper to give the slaves a bath. Five or six slaves could only huddle in a small cage, eating, drinking, sleeping, and sleeping in the cage.
No passion, no dignity, and even no right to commit suicide because of his childhood education.
Many of the female slaves were placed in cages outside without even a piece of rag on their bodies, exposing two pieces of soft flesh to passers-by. This was also a marketing technique, and it was very successful. Old bachelors with rotten teeth would come to admire it every day.
"Sir, do you want to buy a slave? A must for the farm, they are all hard-working and good hands."
"A rare elf slave, only one thousand gold coins!"
"The new store has opened, please come and see it!"
Field was wearing a decent black robe and carrying a stainless steel sword. He had a delicate appearance and looked like a wealthy man. The eyes of the slave traders were shining. They loved to deal with the nobles. First of all, the nobles had strong spending power, unlike the gang of prostitutes who just came here to see and buy. Secondly, the consumption of slaves by the nobles is astonishing, and they become repeat customers within a few days.
In the eyes of the noble lord, slaves are not even as good as the hawks and dogs they raise, and they can be killed casually.
Field scanned the iron cages containing slaves. They didn't even have the basic look in their eyes. They were unkempt and disheveled. It was difficult to tell the difference between men and women based on their faces. There were also hideous whip wounds on their bodies. Occasionally, a slave would look into Field's eyes and immediately lower his head, trembling.
"How much?" According to the map, the green dot was among the slaves. Field asked the price while searching.
"Sir, the prices vary greatly between different races."
The businessman, who looked like the man in Duolai A's dream, rubbed his palms and said, "Goblins, halflings and pigeons all cost 10 silver coins, demi-humans 20 silver coins, and orcs 60 silver coins. If you want to buy toys, hehe, there is no upper limit on the price."
The merchant smiled evilly and pointed at the slaves in large cages in the house. The most eye-catching one was the elf who was bidding one thousand.
She looks extremely beautiful, wearing a revealing gauze, revealing her snow-white skin. But his eyes were dull, like a fool.
"This elf was spoiled by goblins and gave birth to at least twenty-six children. Haha, but it is still a hot commodity. I plan to send it to the auction house. It will not be bought by a thousand gold coins. Do you want to consider it?"
"I'm not interested in her." The green dot was not her, and Field didn't have that much money to buy a toy. He immediately shook his head, "How much does a human slave cost?"
"Humans are smarter and know how to obey better. Male slaves cost 40 silver coins and female slaves cost 25 silver coins, but they are all used for work. If you want to have some fun, I still recommend elves. Even if they are not used for fun, killing for meat or making magic props are all good choices."
Field felt a chill. In this world, nobles were not the elegant and decent beings in TV series, but feudal and brutal villains.
Hearing that the flesh and blood of elves can nourish yin and yang, the proud elves immediately served it on the table, even though they are very similar to humans.
During the chat, Field found the location of the green dot. His eyes moved to the iron cage in the corner. A green dot appeared on the top of the cage like a guide in the game.
He is a demi-human, and a white wolf demi-human. He has red pupils, and his ears and tail are like those of a wolf.
At this time, she was wearing rough linen clothes, lying in a cold and damp cage, motionless, only her eyes occasionally glanced at the key on the merchant's waist.
"It is a rare grassland species. Our slave-catching team spent a lot of effort to break through their stronghold. Those damn barbarians have a very tenacious will to fight." The businessman told the cruel truth with a proud expression. "If you want to play the wolf demi-human, you'd better bring your servants to help. Otherwise, if you are not careful, they may bite them off. You can only understand it but cannot explain it in words."
"Beast-eared girl? "
Field was so excited. As a senior Blue Star otaku, he had no resistance at all to the red-eyed beast-eared girl.
Like teasing a dog, Field carefully reached out his hand and tried to touch her head.
"Huwuwu~"
“You better watch out. "Butler Kaa frowned.
The beast-eared girl let out a threatening growl from her throat, and her scarlet eyes reflected a dangerous light. Knight Captain Connor was ready to draw his sword, "Master Field, it's best not to touch them. I don't want anything to go wrong before going to the Night Leader." "
"There's no need to be so nervous, she's quite cute. "That's what he said. Field was a person who listened to advice and immediately took back his hand. He saw the bravery and frustration in the eyes of the animal-eared girl, which was cute and pitiful. Field adjusted his clothes and said, "How much? "
“Only three gold coins! "The businessman saw Field's lust and raised the price with his eyes closed.
One gold coin was equal to one hundred silver coins, and one silver coin was equal to one hundred copper coins.
Field had a straight face and narrowed his eyes, "I just said that demi-humans only need 20 silver coins. Do you want to play tricks on a noble?" "
"Oh, she is special, very beautiful, isn't she? She had been captured not long ago, so she was guaranteed to be a virgin, and she had not been peeped by the dirty eyes of the untouchables. She is also an exhibit sent to the auction house. With such a superb appearance, it is a pity that she is a demi-human, an unclean creature! Otherwise I won't sell it for 300 gold coins. "
“Fifty silver coins, don’t challenge my patience. "Field crossed his arms across his chest and said in a seductive tone, "I'm going to take over my territory soon, and I won't be the only one buying toys and slaves. Doing business once or doing business countless times, I believe you know the answer. "
"Hiss~" These words scratched the heart of the businessman.
The merchant struggled internally. It was definitely a good idea to make friends with a powerful noble who owned a territory, so he had to grit his teeth and said, "It depends on the quantity you buy. "
The butler glanced at Field in confusion. In the past, Field would not bargain, but would only sympathize with the merchants' difficulties.
Under Field's careful selection, he purchased 100 human slaves and 100 demi-human slaves, 120 of whom were men.
Including the beast-eared girl that Field likes, it costs 53 gold coins.
“Sir, this is the slave’s soul contract, which has been verified by the Chosen One. "
"Contract? "Field took the parchment, with a string of names densely written on it.
"Yes, this is an oath made with the blood of slaves. Anyone who disobeys your will will be burned to ashes by divine fire. The merchant smiled obscenely and handed over the rope holding the slave, "So, you can do whatever you want and have fun, my dear customer." "
"I will. "Field waved his hand. Anyway, if you go to the Cursed Land, if you don't have fun, you will probably be killed by corruption.
